name: Piano Trainer
tagline: Scales, chords, fifths, a quiz. Home row or tap.
description:
A two-octave keyboard. Pick a key and a mode: play the scale, the triads, the sevenths, or walk the circle of fifths. A short quiz asks which key or which fifth.

Tap the keys, or use the home row (A to quote). A MIDI keyboard is optional if this device has one.

Hard mode hides the next note. Shuffle picks a new starting degree each round. Your last key, mode, and quiz score stay in this copy of the app.

Press Practice together, then Invite in the bar above the app, and a friend sees the same prompt.

An unofficial port of Piano Trainer by Zane Helton. The original is a React desktop app that loads a soundfont from the network. This copy does not.
